plotEn:
The power-seeking Asuras have long been in conflict with the Devas. Led by Indra and blessed by the god Vishnu,  the Devas defeat the Asuras, led by Sumali and his daughter Kaikashi. As the Devas rule over Lanka, Kaikashi urges her son Dashanan to avenge their defeat.
Dashanan undertakes years of penance and meditation until the creator god Brahma intervenes. When Brahma rejects his request for immortality, Dashanan instead asks for invincibility against all supernatural beings, which Brahma grants. Returning to Lanka, Dashanan single-handedly defeats the Devas and claims the throne as King Ravana. He then launches a bloody campaign to conquer the realms of the universe. After learning that Ravana had not sought invincibility against humans, Indra appeals to Vishnu for help. Vishnu descends in the form of human avatar as  Prince Rama in  Ayodhya.
In Ayodhya, Rama is born to Kaushalya, one of King Dasharatha's three wives. He grows to be a virtuous bachelor and is well-trained in the martial arts, eventually becoming the most favored among Dasharatha's four sons. Vishvamitra seeks Dasharatha's help in defeating Tataka and Subahu, two rakshasas (demons) who disrupt sacrificial rites. Rama volunteers and is accompanied by his loyal half-brother Lakshmana, with whom he defeats the rakshasas.
